Market today: The market's shrugging off rising Treasury yields, but inflation and spending concerns are pushing the 30-year yield to a 19-year high. This backdrop, coupled with AI driving a potential correction, is a headwind for tech and chip names.

Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL at -46.79% due to its leveraged nature and decay, especially on margin. SPAL is also a concern at -39.66% for similar reasons. The rest are holding, but keep an eye on SMH at -9.79%.

Watch: The 30-year Treasury yield hitting new highs and European central bank warnings about AI-driven corrections.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions and watch for yield-driven selloffs.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given its significant loss and decay, especially on margin.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF is a concern. Evaluate reducing exposure given the -39.66% loss.
SMH: Watch the stop at 540. A break below could signal further downside.
